# Horizon for iOS and iPadOS support

Report bugs and request features in [heyskylo/horizon-ios/issues](https://github.com/heyskylo/horizon-ios/issues). Include the device model, iOS/iPadOS version, Horizon build number, steps to reproduce, and any relevant pack names or logs.

For installation and Microsoft sign-in, start with the [mobile README](../README.md). Builds are available from [Releases](https://github.com/heyskylo/horizon-ios/releases) and the [iOS build workflow](https://github.com/heyskylo/horizon-ios/actions/workflows/ios.yml). Code contributions go through [this fork’s pull requests](https://github.com/heyskylo/horizon-ios/pulls).

The shared engine documentation contains links to upstream bug fixes and design discussions. Keep those numbered references attached to their original issues; file new mobile-port reports in the tracker above.
